Anya (Support): escalated from ticket #6129 — customer acme-prod reports p95 jumped from ~2.1s to ~6.8s in the last 30m, p99 ~12s, several 504s. They've provided repro curl and say impact is front-page search. opening here for triage. https://tickets.internal/6129 :eyes:
James (SRE): ack. can you paste the tenant id + sample request headers? any rate/traffic change?
Anya (Support): tenant=acme-prod, example curl attached: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-ACME" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-medium","input":"search query","max_tokens":40}'
```
Traffic steady, but they said a client-side retry storm hit ~10:15 UTC. errors show `timeout waiting for response` from our gateway.
Lucas (EngRuntime): likely request pileup + queueing. check worker in-flight and backlog for acme-prod. running queries: `sum(rate(requests[1m])) by (tenant)` and `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, tenant))` — any results?
Rita (Oncall): I just pulled worker metrics — acme-prod concurrency at nodes: 95/100 inflight, backlog queue length ~420, enqueue time p95 ~320ms. autoscaler hasn't kicked (seen cooldown). Suspect admission_control is tripping and causing retries leading to thundering herd.
Alex (EngPlatform): quick mitigation options: 1) increase per-tenant max_inflight temporarily, 2) move tenant to reserved pool, 3) enable short-circuit fail-fast for heavy requests to avoid long queueing. prefer (1) for fastest change.
James (SRE): agree. also lower batching window for acme-prod to reduce per-request latency; that avoids long assembly waits. prepare small config change and patch.
Lucas (EngRuntime): admin API supports hot-update. example to bump max_inflight for tenant:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/v1/tenants/acme-prod/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"admission_control": {"max_inflight": 160, "burst": 50, "soft_stop": true}}'
```
I'll standby to apply if ops wants. note: `soft_stop=true` keeps graceful shedding but allows temporary burst.
Rita (Oncall): go for it. applying now. @deploy-bot please run the config deployment for tenant acme-prod (hotpatch, non-prod first).
deploy-bot: starting hotpatch: acme-prod admission_control update -> rolling to 4 nodes. smoke tests scheduled.
Anya (Support): sent customer a mitigation ETA (10m) and asked them to avoid retry loops. ticket updated.
deploy-bot: hotpatch complete on 4 nodes, smoke tests passed.
James (SRE): immediate telemetry shows p95 dropping from 6.8s -> 2.4s within 2 minutes, backlog drain rate increasing. p99 down to ~4.2s. still watching for autoscale cooldown.
Anya (Support): customer confirms latency improving and no more 504s. they're holding off retries.
Lucas (EngRuntime): follow-ups: 1) tweak autoscaler cooldown to be more aggressive for tenant pools with bursty traffic, 2) add per-tenant retry budget guidance in docs and client SDKs, 3) add an alert on sustained backlog >300 for 5m. filing infra tickets.
Rita (Oncall): leaving note: if we see repeat within 24h, move acme-prod to reserved pool for stability.
Anya (Support): closing the slack escalation, will mark ticket with root cause: transient retry storm + admission control conservatism; mitigated with temp max_inflight bump + batching window change. thanks all :heart:
